title: Mounted Walk completes through an area transition

verification.actor: MOUNTED species 155 (cyndaquil), acquired through mount; live handle and attached presentation required
verification.trigger: Place the disposable fixture at map 33 (671,402), mount the current Cyndaquil, hold Right through the field change, release input while the rebound Walk finishes, then complete one Right recovery Walk
verification.observable: Map 33 changes once to map 60; the same mounted Cyndaquil lifetime rebinds to the new field context; its elapsed-zero rebound Walk completes with one commit, paired presentation and ordered lifecycle; one recovery Walk returns idle control

setupMutations.change: Use the checked teleport command to place the disposable test.sav fixture at map 33 (671,402); heal own party slot 0; mount that slot; settle and bind the current Cyndaquil before observation.

limits: Prepared teleport and party setup give no movement or transition credit.
The case proves one Route 29 boundary and does not prove every field boundary or every mounted locomotion kind.
Registration alone is not runtime acceptance; the checked shared test must pass on the current ROM.

events.value: Prepare map 33 (671,402), mount own Cyndaquil, settle, and bind its current live identity
Hold Right until map 33 changes to map 60 and the rebound Walk starts at elapsed zero
Release input and require the rebound Walk to commit once with paired player and Pokemon positions
Tap Right once and let the same rebound mounted actor complete one recovery Walk

stop.condition: The map change, elapsed-zero rebound Walk, and one recovery Walk finish

invariants: Each accepted motion has exactly one terminal result

No active actors share a nonzero target reservation
